text:
neel: Quick flag 1: spun up harlequin13b int8 candidate on staging. Strong token savings but some multi-paragraph "coverage" regressions on meeting-summary and policy-synthesis slices. Need one-pager for GTN/PM.

sam: paste the smoke numbers please.

neel: smoke snapshot: 
```
fp16 baseline: cost_per_token = $0.0108, p95 = 150ms, baseline_accept = 0.81
int8 candidate: cost_per_token = $0.0034, p95 = 168ms, accept = 0.69
longform recall (6k) = -11.4pp, short (256) = -1.6pp
kv-cache hit ~80% on sampled traffic
```

tara: 11pp long recall drop is concerning. Failure type? missing steps or hallucination?

neel: Mostly missing steps / incomplete enumerations. Hallucination delta small (~+0.4pp). Prompt boosting recovers ~2-3pp.

sam: Quick econ calc with avg_tokens=700: 
```
fp16_pp = 0.0108
int8_pp = 0.0034
avg_t = 700
savings_per_req = (fp16_pp - int8_pp) * avg_t = $5.18
```

tara: If a quality hit reduces critical-flow conversions, that $5 saving could be offset. Suggest route-by-intent: int8 for drafts/low-risk; fp16 for final/export / flagged users. Hybrid (attention fp16) seems to recover ~6pp and costs ~+20% vs int8.

neel: kicked off 600-sample labeled eval on synthesis + meeting slices. Ops canary running in us-west.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started harlequin13b-int8 in staging (1 GPU). eval job: https://internal/evals/harlequin13b/600

sam: rollout gate idea: require long_recall >= -7pp AND accept_drop <= 3pp on 24h rolling window; otherwise holdback. Add automatic rollback if accept_drop >4pp over 12h.

neel: 600-sample TL;DR: int8 long_recall = -9.8pp, accept_drop = 4.2pp; hybrid long_recall = -3.8pp, accept_drop = 1.7pp. Hybrid still ~1.9x cheaper than fp16.

tara: Proposed action: mixed fleet. Default hybrid for medium/long outputs, int8 for ephemeral/drafts, fp16 pinned for high-stakes final outputs. Drafting scorecard now with cost sims for avg_tokens=[200,700,1400].

sam: also include sensitivity table linking conversion impact to LTV to compute break-even monthly volumes. I'll prepare routing flag criteria.

neel: created INF-2710 to track canary, scorecard, and A/B plan. Will attach eval CSV and representative failures.

tara: quick note to GTN/PM: 600-sample is noisy; recommend 2k-sample A/B before broad shift. I'll sync with PM for conversion sensitivity.

neel: posting one-pager shortly. Thanks. :rocket:
